definitions: The part of a human or animal body connecting the head to the rest of the body.
A narrow part of something, especially one connecting two larger parts.
The part of a garment that fits around the neck.
The part of a bottle or similar container that is narrowest, near the opening.
examples: She wore a scarf around her neck.
The neck of the violin is made of maple.
The dress had a high neck.
He poured the wine from the neck of the bottle.
